ModMetaData.name: Caravans Critically Enhanced
ModMetaData.author: Zei33
ModMetaData.description: In development, and not yet released. So far it adds a Load work type next to Haul: colonists who are not going with a forming caravan help load it and lead its pen animals to it, and loading carries on while any listed item can still be fetched. Drafting a colonist leading animals for a caravan no longer drops its leads. A caravan leaves by a map edge inside the allowed area of every pawn restricted to one, away from hostiles where it can, and if no edge fits every area it packs and waits at its spot, with an alert, until one does. When finished it will fix the other slow and fragile parts of forming a caravan as well: cargo already on pack animals will stay listed, and drafted colonists will be able to leave from the edge they stand at.
